zh: 随机游走（最简单的样板）
en: Random walk (the simplest template)

zh: 每一步的涨跌互相独立，只有一个固定的漂移和一个固定的波动。
en: The moves of different steps are independent; there is just one fixed drift and one fixed volatility.

zh: 年化漂移 μ
en: Annualized drift μ

zh: 年化波动 σ
en: Annualized volatility σ

zh:
和内置的"几何布朗运动"是同一个过程，放在这里当样板：十行代码就是一个世界。

每一步的对数收益独立同分布，过去的价格对猜下一步没有任何帮助，所以择时的规则在这里都是白忙。长期增长率最高的做法是一直把固定比例 f = μ/σ² 的钱放在这个资产上（Merton 的结论）。
en:
The same process as the built-in "Geometric Brownian motion", placed here as a template: ten lines of code make a world.

The log returns of the steps are independent and identically distributed, and past prices are of no help in guessing the next step, so market-timing rules get nowhere here. The highest long-run growth rate comes from always keeping the fixed fraction f = μ/σ² of wealth in this asset (Merton's result).

zh: // 最简单的世界：每一步的对数收益互相独立，分布也都一样。
en: // The simplest world: the log returns of the steps are independent and all have the same distribution.

zh: // mu、sigma 是按年给的；K 是每年几步，所以一步的时间是 dt = 1/K。
en: // mu and sigma are given per year; K is the number of steps per year, so one step lasts dt = 1/K.

zh: 涨跌停板
en: Daily price limits

zh: 每天的涨跌幅有上限；当天没走完的行情留到第二天接着走。
en: Each day's move is capped; the part of the move that was cut off carries over to the next day.

zh: 每天涨跌幅的上限
en: Cap on each day's move

zh:
没有涨跌停的时候，这是一个没有漂移的随机游走。加上涨跌停之后，当天没走完的幅度留到第二天，所以涨停的第二天多半接着涨，跌停的第二天多半接着跌：相邻两天的收益有了正的相关。上限相对于每天的波动（σ/√K）越紧，这种延续越明显。

可以试的规则：内置的"时间序列动量"（把回看窗口调成 1 步）在这里比买入持有好得多；把涨跌幅的上限调到 0.2（几乎碰不到），它的优势就没有了，只剩下交易成本。

要留意的一点：真实的市场里，涨停的时候往往买不进去。这个世界没有管这件事，所以这里的收益比现实里拿得到的高得多。
en:
Without the price limits this is a random walk with no drift. With them, the part of the day's move that was cut off carries over to the next day, so a limit-up day tends to be followed by another rise and a limit-down day by another fall: the returns of adjacent days become positively correlated. The tighter the cap relative to the daily volatility (σ/√K), the stronger this continuation.

A rule to try: the built-in "Time-series momentum" (with the lookback window set to 1 step) does far better than buy and hold here; raise the cap to 0.2 (hardly ever reached) and its advantage is gone, leaving only the trading costs.

One thing to keep in mind: in a real market you often cannot buy on a limit-up day. This world ignores that, so the returns here are far higher than what could be obtained in reality.

zh: // 每天的涨跌幅不许超过 ±lim（按对数算）。没走完的行情不会消失，留到第二天接着走。
en: // Each day's move may not exceed ±lim (in log terms). The part that was cut off does not vanish; it carries over to the next day.

zh: var want = carry + sd * rng.normal();              // 今天想走的幅度
en: var want = carry + sd * rng.normal();              // the move the price wants to make today

zh: var r = Math.max(-p.lim, Math.min(p.lim, want));   // 实际只能走到涨跌停
en: var r = Math.max(-p.lim, Math.min(p.lim, want));   // it can only go as far as the limit

zh: carry = want - r;                                  // 没走完的留给明天
en: carry = want - r;                                  // the rest is left for tomorrow

zh: 掷骰子，见好就收
en: Roll the die, quit while ahead

zh: 一直掷骰子攒分，掷出 1 就前功尽弃。什么时候收手？
en: Keep rolling a die to pile up points; a 1 wipes everything out. When do you stop?

zh:
一局里你可以一直掷骰子。掷出 2 到 6，点数加进这一局的累计；掷出 1，累计清零，这一局结束，一分没有。每次掷之前你都可以收手，把累计的分数带走。

规则每回合看到的是眼下的累计分数（s.see），报 1 是接着掷，报别的数是收手。

算一笔账：累计是 s 分的时候再掷一次，有 1/6 的机会丢掉 s 分，有 5/6 的机会平均多得 4 分。两头相等时 s = 20，所以攒到 20 分就该收手。
en:
In one episode you may keep rolling a die. A roll of 2 to 6 is added to this episode's running total; a roll of 1 resets the total to zero and ends the episode with no points. Before every roll you may stop and take the running total with you.

Each round the rule sees the current running total (s.see); returning 1 means roll again, and any other number means stop.

Do the sum: rolling once more with a total of s loses s points with probability 1/6 and gains 4 points on average with probability 5/6. The two sides balance at s = 20, so you should stop once you reach 20 points.

zh: // 发牌：把这一局可能用到的骰子先掷好，藏起来。pot 是眼下的累计分数。
en: // Deal: roll in advance all the dice this episode might use, and hide them. pot is the current running total.

zh: // 亮牌：规则看到的是眼下累计了多少分。
en: // Show: the rule sees the current running total.

zh: // 判分：规则报 1 是接着掷，报别的是收手。收手时，累计的分数就是这一局的得分。
en: // Referee: returning 1 means roll again, anything else means stop. On stopping, the running total is the score of this episode.

zh: if (t === G.dice.length - 1) { G.over = true; return G.pot; }   // 回合用完了：算作收手
en: if (t === G.dice.length - 1) { G.over = true; return G.pot; }   // out of rounds: counts as stopping

zh: 掷一次就收
en: Stop after one roll

zh: 有分就走。拿来当基准。
en: Leaves as soon as it has points. Used as the benchmark.

zh: 攒到 20 分就收
en: Stop at 20 points

zh: 累计不到 c 分就接着掷。c = 20 时平均得分最高。
en: Keeps rolling while the total is below c. The average score is highest at c = 20.

zh: 太贪：攒到 40 分才收
en: Too greedy: stop only at 40 points

zh: 同一条规则，c = 40。多数时候等不到 40 分就掷出 1 了。
en: The same rule with c = 40. Most of the time a 1 turns up before the total reaches 40.

zh: 猜下一次是正是反
en: Guess heads or tails

zh: 硬币是偏的，偏多少不知道。每回合猜下一次的结果，猜对得 1 分。
en: The coin is biased, by an unknown amount. Each round you guess the next flip; a correct guess scores 1 point.

zh:
每一局换一枚硬币：正面的概率 q 在 lo 和 hi 之间随机抽一个，规则不知道 q 是多少。每回合先猜这一次抛出来是正面还是反面，猜对得 1 分；然后才看到结果。

规则每回合看到的是上一次抛出来的结果（s.see：1 是正面，0 是反面，第一回合还没有，是 NaN），报 1 是猜正面，报别的数是猜反面。

要是知道 q，永远猜可能性大的那一面，每回合平均得 max(q, 1 − q) 分。不知道 q，就只能一边猜一边数。
en:
Each episode uses a new coin: the probability q of heads is drawn at random between lo and hi, and the rule does not know q. Each round you first guess whether this flip will be heads or tails, scoring 1 point if correct; only then do you see the result.

Each round the rule sees the result of the previous flip (s.see: 1 is heads, 0 is tails; in the first round there is none yet, so it is NaN); returning 1 means guess heads, and any other number means guess tails.

If you knew q, you would always guess the more likely side and score max(q, 1 − q) points per round on average. Without knowing q, all you can do is count while you guess.

zh: // 发牌：抽一枚硬币（正面的概率 q），把这一局的 T 次都先抛好，藏起来。
en: // Deal: draw a coin (probability q of heads), flip it T times in advance for this episode, and hide the results.

zh: // 亮牌：规则看到的是上一次抛出来的结果（第一回合还没有）。
en: // Show: the rule sees the result of the previous flip (none yet in the first round).

zh: // 判分：规则报 1 是猜正面，报别的都算猜反面。猜对得 1 分。
en: // Referee: returning 1 means guess heads, anything else counts as tails. A correct guess scores 1 point.

zh: 总猜正面
en: Always guess heads

zh: 什么也不看。拿来当基准。
en: Looks at nothing. Used as the benchmark.

zh: 上次是什么就猜什么
en: Guess whatever came last

zh: 只看上一次的结果。
en: Looks only at the previous result.

zh: 跟着多数猜
en: Follow the majority

zh: 数一数到现在正面多还是反面多，猜多的那一面。
en: Counts whether heads or tails has come up more often so far and guesses that side.

zh: deal 要返回一个对象（这一局藏起来的东西），现在返回的是 §0§
en: deal must return an object (what is hidden in this episode); it returned §0§

zh: 第 §0§ 回合，referee 返回的不是有限的数：§1§
en: Round §0§: referee returned something that is not a finite number: §1§

zh: 玩法的代码里要有 deal(T, rng, p) 和 referee(G, t, a) 这两个函数
en: The game's code must contain the two functions deal(T, rng, p) and referee(G, t, a)

zh: 代码里没有定义 decide(s, p, st) 函数
en: The code does not define a decide(s, p, st) function

zh: 代码里没有定义 simulate(T, rng, p, K) 函数
en: The code does not define a simulate(T, rng, p, K) function
